raw.details:
Eligibility

  • Students from any academic background, specialization, or college can participate.
  • Participants can register individually or in teams of 1–2 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Participants must complete the registration process as instructed by the organizers.

Competition Format

The competition will consist of three rounds:

Round 1: Profile Submission

Participants must submit their profiles and basic details. Submissions will be reviewed to determine eligibility for the next round.

Round 2: Problem Statement & Tool Utilization

Qualified participants will receive problem statements and tools to utilize for developing their solutions. Participants must understand the assigned problem and use the available tools to build their projects.

Round 3: Final Project Submission

Participants must submit their completed projects along with the project description, solution approach, and relevant project links or demonstrations, as instructed by the organizers.

The duration of each round and submission deadlines will be communicated by the organizers.

Prizes and Rewards

  • First Prize: ₹5,000
  • Second Prize: ₹3,000
  • Third Prize: ₹2,000
  • Total Prize Pool: ₹10,000
  • Additional Rewards: Platform credits for all eligible participants, subject to applicable terms.

Competition Rules

  • Participants must provide accurate information during registration and profile submission.
  • Each team must consist of 1–2 members.
  • Participants from different colleges and academic specializations can form teams.
  • Projects must address the assigned problem statement and follow the instructions provided by the organizers.
  • All submissions must be completed before the announced deadlines.
  • Plagiarism, fraudulent submissions, or misrepresentation of project work may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow all applicable tool usage policies and platform terms.
  • The organizers reserve the right to evaluate submissions and make final decisions regarding eligibility, results, and prize distribution.

Community & Updates

Join the official WhatsApp group for competition announcements, round-wise instructions, deadlines, and updates here.

Participants are encouraged to join the group and regularly check for updates from the organizers.
